title: Foo Bar Taxi Langfuse Tracing
description: Instrument a pre-scaffolded NL-to-SQL taxi query agent with Langfuse tracing so every invocation — question, tool calls, SQL queries, and response — is captured as a trace.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must add Langfuse observability to an existing Node.js query agent that translates natural-language questions into ClickHouse SQL against 3M+ rows of NYC taxi trip data.

tasks.description: Integrate Langfuse SDK into the pre-scaffolded NL query agent so each invocation produces a trace with spans for tool calls, generations for LLM calls, and metadata for the SQL query and response.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with 3M+ rows of NYC taxi trip data in raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01. A basic NL query agent is scaffolded in /workspace/ but has no tracing instrumentation.
